title: Disney's parks division earns twice what its movies, TV and Disney+ do

hook.a: Disney's parks earn more than twice what its movies, TV shows and Disney Plus make.
hook.b: Disney is a theme park company with a film studio attached.

scenes.vo: [flat, confident] Disney's parks earn more than twice what its movies, TV shows and Disney Plus make.
scenes.sub: parks' operating income vs movies, TV & Disney+, FY2025
scenes.source: Disney FY2025 Q4 earnings release · FY2025 segment operating income

scenes.vo: [matter-of-fact] The parks division is parks, cruises and merchandise.
Last year it made ten billion dollars in operating income.
scenes.source: Disney FY2025 Q4 earnings release · FY2025 segment operating income

scenes.vo: [lowered, curious] So how do parks beat Marvel, Pixar and Disney Plus?
[excited, sharing a find] The parks keep about twenty-eight cents of every dollar.
scenes.source: Disney FY2025 Q4 earnings release · FY2025 segment revenue

scenes.vo: Movies, TV and streaming keep about eleven cents.
scenes.source: Disney FY2025 Q4 earnings release · FY2025 segment revenue

scenes.vo: [calm, sure] The films sell the characters.
[quiet, knowing] The parks sell the tickets.
